label: Universal origin bridge holds iff its self-edge sibling and its distinct-relata clause hold
paraphrase: For every cause frame and exercise vocabulary (Occurs, bearer, produces): every origin edge is realized by its source's productive exercise if and only if every self-origin edge is realized by the self-originator's productive exercise and every origin edge is either a self-edge or realized by its source's productive exercise. A comparison of the two encodings; it asserts neither bridge.
